suggestions.title: Add unit tests for content-safety.ts (93 lines, pure functions, 0 tests)
suggestions.description: Content Safety utilities (src/agent-framework/core/utils/content-safety.ts) are critical for children's safety: they filter prohibited words, redact PII, and inject encouragement text. Currently 0 test coverage. These are pure functions with no DI — easy to test exhaustively. Test cases: filterProhibitedWords (basic, edge cases: empty string, special chars, mixed content), redactPii (phone patterns, ID patterns, password patterns), isContentSafe (safe content, unsafe content, boundary cases), filterContent (full pipeline, wasFiltered flag, encouragement text injection).

suggestions.title: Add unit tests for json-extraction.ts (115 lines, pure functions, 0 tests)
suggestions.description: JSON Extraction utilities (src/agent-framework/core/utils/json-extraction.ts) are central to LLM output parsing — used by agent-executor, generate-activity, generate-quiz, and generate-video-data. Currently 0 test coverage. Pure functions, no DI. Test cases: extractJsonObject (direct parse, json code block, generic code block, brace slice, edge cases: null, empty, nested objects, malformed JSON, multiple blocks), extractJsonArray (direct parse, code block, bracket slice, edge cases), containsJson (positive cases, negative cases, edge cases).

suggestions.title: Add unit tests for thinking-parser.ts (42 lines, pure functions, 0 tests)
suggestions.description: Thinking Parser (src/agent-framework/core/utils/thinking-parser.ts) handles MiniMax reasoning format and standard <think> blocks. Used by both agent-executor (stripThinking) and llm-client (stripThinking). 0 tests. Pure function, no DI. Test cases: stripThinking (standard format, MiniMax format, unclosed think, nested content, no think block, empty string, null), extractThinking (standard, MiniMax, unclosed, no match), hasThinkingBlock (positive, negative, edge cases like partial word matches).
